course_name_en: BLM4400 — Current Topics in Computer Engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire the ability to learn basic concepts on the most current topics related to Computer Engineering.
Acquire the ability to develop applications using the most current topics and technologies related to Computer Engineering.
Acquire the necessary skills to evaluate applications related to the most current topics and technologies in Computer Engineering based on criteria such as performance, scalability, and usability.
Acquire the ability to comprehend and apply proposed approaches on the most current topics related to Computer Engineering.
Acquire the ability to apply proposed models on the most current topics related to Computer Engineering.

syllabus_topics: Ability to conduct literature review on the chosen topic in Computer Engineering
Ability to write aims, importance, assumptions, limitations, and definitions appropriate to the research topic in Computer Engineering - I
Ability to write aims, importance, assumptions, limitations, and definitions appropriate to the research topic in Computer Engineering - II
Ability to perform basic statistical operations and analyses on research topic data in Computer Engineering - I
Ability to perform basic statistical operations and analyses on research topic data in Computer Engineering - II
Ability to explain the characteristics related to the interpretation of findings in the research topic in Computer Engineering - I
Ability to explain the characteristics related to the interpretation of findings in the research topic in Computer Engineering - II
Ability to interpret the findings obtained in the research topic in Computer Engineering - I
Ability to interpret the findings obtained in the research topic in Computer Engineering - II
Ability to develop proposals based on the results of the research topic in Computer Engineering
Ability to write a summary of the studies conducted on the research topic in Computer Engineering - I
Ability to write a summary of the studies conducted on the research topic in Computer Engineering - II
bibliography: Ersin Elbaşı, Mehmet S. Aktas, "Research On Computer Science, Computer And Electronics Engineering", Book, VDM Verlag ISBN: 3639120035, 2009.
